derivation.source: Armstrong et al. Clin Genitourin Cancer 2022; 169 mCRPC patients
derivation.reasoning: BSI ~3% at diagnosis, doubles at progression (~6%), max observed ~10-20%. Ratio diagnosis/max ≈ 0.15-0.30
derivation.note: Low end of range. Could be 0.20-0.25. Affects TTP absolute value but not HR ratio.

clinical_check.mCRPC_untreated_not_observed: all patients receive treatment, no true untreated control
